anmeldesperre.hat-der-anmeldeschutz-nach: {zeitraum} sign-in protection locked {teile} after failed attempts.
anmeldesperre.angriffsversuche-aus-dem-i: Attack attempts from the internet are normal; the locks happen automatically. You don’t need to do anything as long as you don’t find your own addresses among them.
anmeldesperre.die-fuenf-mit-den: The five with the most failed attempts:
anmeldesperre.gesperrte-benutzerkonten-j: Locked user accounts (per email address and IP):
anmeldesperre.gesperrte-adressen-entsper: Lift locked sign-ins: Workbench → Sign-in protection.
anmeldesperre.ausnahmen-ist-keine-ip: Exceptions: {schlecht} isn’t an IP address or a network such as 192.168.0.0/16.
anmeldesperre.von-dieser-adresse-kamen: Too many failed sign-ins came from this address. Locked until {wert}.
anmeldesperre.von-dieser-adresse-kamen-2: Too many failed sign-ins came from this address. It is locked until an administrator unlocks it.
anmeldesperre.konto-gebremst_one: Too many failed attempts for this account came from different addresses. Signing in with a password is slowed down for one minute.
anmeldesperre.konto-gebremst_other: Too many failed attempts for this account came from different addresses. Signing in with a password is slowed down for {anzahl} minutes.
anmeldesperre.zu-viele-fehlversuche-bitt: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in one minute.
Too many failed attempts. Please try again in {anzahl} minutes.
anmeldesperre.passwortpruefung-voll: A great many sign-ins are happening right now. Please try again in a few seconds.
anmeldesperre.ablago-benutzerkonto-nach: Ablago: user account locked after failed attempts
anmeldesperre.fuer-kamen-von-falsche_one:
For {email}, {versuche} wrong passwords in a row came from {ip}. Sign-in from this address is locked for one minute.

If that wasn’t the user themselves, someone is trying to guess the password. No further instant report about this account comes today.

Unlock: Workbench → Sign-in protection → Locked sign-ins.
Settings: Workbench → Build the library → Automations.
anmeldesperre.fuer-kamen-von-falsche_oth:

Unlock: Workbench → Sign-in protection → Locked sign-ins.

apischluessel.bitte-einen-namen-angeben: Please enter a name, e.g. “Office scanner”.
apischluessel.ablaufdatum-ist-kein-guelt: The expiry date isn’t a valid date.
apischluessel.das-ablaufdatum-liegt-in: The expiry date is in the past.
apischluessel.unbekanntes-schluesselform: Unknown key format. Expected: Authorization: Bearer dms_…
apischluessel.dieser-api-schluessel-ist: This API key is invalid or has been deleted.
geheimnisse.nach-dem-wiederherstellen-in: enter again in the library after restoring
geheimnisse.in-der-werkbank-unter: enter again in the Workbench under “Email and address”
geheimnisse.in-der-werkbank-unter-2: enter again in the Workbench under “Mailboxes”
geheimnisse.in-der-werkbank-unter-3: enter again in the Workbench under “Mailboxes” for the app
geheimnisse.in-der-werkbank-unter-4: sign in again in the Workbench under “Mailboxes”
geheimnisse.anmeldung-ueber-einen-anbiet: Sign-in through a provider (OIDC: client secret)
geheimnisse.in-der-werkbank-unter-5: enter again in the Workbench under “Sign-in protection”
geheimnisse.unter-benutzer-zuruecksetzen: reset under “Users”; the user sets it up again
geheimnisse.der-benutzer-loescht-sie: the user deletes them under “My account → Security” and remembers them again
geheimnisse.in-den-einstellungen-des: enter again in the package’s settings
geheimnisse.aufruf: Calls from outside (secret for the signature)
geheimnisse.aufruf.wo: choose “New secret” in the automation and enter it at the caller
geheimnisse.pruefwort-zeigt-ob-der: Check word (shows whether the key fits)
geheimnisse.wird-mit-einem-neuen: is set again with a new key
geheimnisse.bitte-melden-diese-art: please report – the display doesn’t know this kind yet
konten.link-ohne-adresse: No email sent: Without a configured address, Ablago does not send links by email. Enter it under Workbench → Email and address; until then, pass on the link shown here.
konten.du-agierst-gerade-nicht: You aren’t acting as another user right now.
konten.diese-e-mail-adresse: This email address is already used by another user.
konten.bitte-ein-gueltiges-datum: Please enter a valid date for “{was}”.
konten.als-vertreter-bitte-einen: Please choose another user as the stand-in.
konten.der-vertreter-muss-ein: The stand-in must be an active user.
konten.fuer-diese-e-mail: There is already a user for this email address.
konten.hat-noch-offene-aufgaben_one: {wert} still has one open task. Please hand it to the stand-in first.
konten.hat-noch-offene-aufgaben_other: {wert} still has {anzahl} open tasks. Please hand them to the stand-in first.
konten.wer-sich-schon-angemeldet: Anyone who has already signed in is deactivated instead of deleted. That way links and “created by” are kept.
oidc.die-adresse-des-anbieters: The provider’s address isn’t a valid URL.
oidc.der-anbieter-muss-ueber: The provider must be reachable via https (http only in your own network).
oidc.die-adresse-des-anbieters-2: The provider’s address must not have ? or # parts.
oidc.id-token-mit-nicht: ID token with a method that isn’t allowed: {wert}.
oidc.die-signatur-des-id: The ID token’s signature doesn’t match.
oidc.das-id-token-stammt: The ID token comes from a different issuer.
oidc.das-id-token-ist: The ID token was issued for a different application.
oidc.das-id-token-ist-2: The ID token has expired. Check the time on the server and the provider.
oidc.das-id-token-ist-3: The ID token was issued in the future. Check the time on the server and the provider.
oidc.das-id-token-gehoert: The ID token doesn’t belong to this sign-in.
oidc.das-id-token-nennt: The ID token names no user.
oidc.zum-id-token-passt: No key of the provider matches the ID token.
oidc.der-anbieter-hat-die: The provider hasn’t confirmed the email address.
oidc.der-anbieter-liefert-keine: The provider delivers no email address. Please allow the scope “email” at the provider.
oidc.zum-einschalten-bitte-adresse: To switch on, please enter the provider’s address and client ID.
oidc.der-anbieter-liefert-keine-2: The provider delivers no OpenID configuration (HTTP {status}). Is the address right?
oidc.die-openid-konfiguration-des: The provider’s OpenID configuration is incomplete.
oidc.der-anbieter-nennt-sich: The provider calls itself {issuer} – please enter exactly this address.
oidc.die-schluessel-des-anbieters: The provider’s keys can’t be retrieved (HTTP {status}).
oidc.die-schluessel-des-anbieters-2: The provider’s keys can’t be read.
oidc.bitte-zuerst-die-adresse: Please enter the provider’s address first.
oidc.die-anmeldung-ueber-einen: Sign-in through a provider isn’t switched on.
oidc.zu-viele-offene-anmeldungen: Too many open sign-ins. Please try again in a moment.
oidc.die-anmeldung-ist-abgelaufen: The sign-in has expired. Please start again.
oidc.die-anmeldung-wurde-in: The sign-in was started in a different browser. Please start again.
oidc.das-client-secret-ist: The client secret can’t be read with the current key. Please enter it again in the Workbench.
oidc.der-anbieter-hat-den: The provider didn’t redeem the code: {wert}
tresor.wechseln-geht-nur-mit: Changing only works with a matching key. See the state under Workbench → Encryption.
tresor.der-schluessel-wird-gerade: The key is being changed right now.
tresor.der-neue-schluessel-liess: The new key couldn’t be written ({neueDatei}): {message}. The previous key still applies.
tresor.der-schluesselwechsel-ist: The key change has been cancelled; the previous key still applies. ({message})
tresor.es-gibt-schon-einen: There is already a key. To exchange it there is “Change key”.
tresor.die-schluesseldatei-gehoert-nicht: The key file {datei} doesn’t belong to the saved passwords. Put the right file back or remove it to create a new key.
tresor.unter-liegt-schon-eine: There is already a file under {datei}. Reload the page or restart Ablago so that it is read.
tresor.die-schluesseldatei-liess-sich: The key file couldn’t be written ({datei}): {message}
tresor.die-schluesseldatei-passt-nicht: The key file doesn’t match the saved passwords. Passwords can only be saved again once that has been cleared up (Workbench → Encryption).
tresor.passwoerter-lassen-sich-erst: Passwords can only be saved once there is a key. Whoever administers Ablago creates it in the Workbench under “Encryption”.
zweifaktor.bitte-die-einrichtung-neu: Please start the setup again (the QR code expires after 10 minutes).
zweifaktor.der-code-stimmt-nicht: The code is wrong. Check the time on your phone and on Ablago and enter the current code.
zweifaktor.die-zwei-faktor-anmeldung: Two-factor sign-in is not set up.
konten.sprache-nicht-erlaubt: This language isn’t allowed in your library. Choose one from the list.
geheimnisse.aussen.wo: choose "New secret" on the "Call URL" card and enter it at the receiver
